body:
The parentheses aren't needed here (same for the rest of the block):

```suggestion
					blend_factors[2] = state.transparent_render_target ? GL_ONE : GL_ZERO;
```

I have removed the parens in cases where the controlling expression was just a variable. It wasn't clear to me whether you also wanted them removed in cases where the variable was being compared for equality against another value, so I left them in.

Write numbers with the digit for better readability:

```suggestion
						_set_error(vformat(RTR("Unexpected token: '%s'; blend mode list must consist of exactly 4 mode names, separated by commas)."), get_token_text(tk)));
```
